title: Blade
synopsis: A half-vampire, half-mortal man-turned-protector of the human race slaughters evil vampires to avenge his mother's death.
reason_for_inclusion: Historic first commercial box office blockbuster under Marvel licensing.

title: X-Men
synopsis: Two mutants come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.
reason_for_inclusion: Inaugural film of the 13-film 20th Century Fox X-Men franchise.

title: Spider-Man
synopsis: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider, high school student Peter Parker gains spider-like abilities and uses them to fight crime in New York City.
reason_for_inclusion: Original theatrical film directed by Sam Raimi that set modern box-office milestones.

title: Daredevil (Marvel Television Series)
universe: Marvel Cinematic Universe / The Defenders Saga
synopsis: A blind lawyer by day uses his heightened senses to fight crime as a masked vigilante by night in Hell's Kitchen, New York City.
reason_for_inclusion: Critical flagship series of Marvel Television's Netflix lineup, canonically re-integrated into the MCU.

title: Werewolf by Night
synopsis: On a dark and somber night, a secret cabal of monster hunters emerge from the shadows and gather at the Bloodstone Temple following the death of their leader.
reason_for_inclusion: Marvel Studios' inaugural medium-length Special Presentation.

title: Spider-Man: The Animated Series
synopsis: Peter Parker balances college life, photojournalism, and superheroics while facing classic rogues in 1990s New York.
reason_for_inclusion: Foundational 65-episode animated adaptation defining the character for an entire generation.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Teenager Miles Morales becomes the new Spider-Man and joins other Spider-heroes from parallel dimensions to stop a threat to all realities.

title: The Consultant
synopsis: Agents Coulson and Sitwell conspire to ensure Emil Blonsky is not released to join the Avengers Initiative.
reason_for_inclusion: The first official Marvel One-Shot released to bridge MCU theatrical continuity.
